entries.zh: 出汗，流汗（汗自体表而出）
entries.en: to sweat; to perspire
entries.notes: 西语 sudar（出汗）与汉字「汗出」、闽南音栏 hân chus 互证；M 栏末尾符号存疑，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 发汗，（病人）发汗出汗；亦指发汗退病之法
entries.en: to sweat, said of the sick person; to bring out a sweat (diaphoretic treatment)
entries.notes: 词头为 sudar el enfermo（病人出汗），与「發汗」及闽南音 hiat han 相合；M 栏 hiat/hiân 拼写存疑，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 夫，丈夫；本条系于 suegro（岳父、夫之父）词头下，对应之义存疑，M 栏 tiang 或涉「丈」字
entries.en: husband (fu); entered under suegro (father-in-law), correspondence doubtful
entries.notes: R 栏涂划残损（尾部似 uenic）不可读；「夫/tio,tiang」与 suegro 之义对不齐，故降置信。

entries.zh: 岳，岳父之省称，指妻之父；西语 suegro
entries.en: yue, short form for wife's father; father-in-law (suegro)
entries.notes: L 栏 suego/suegro 拼写存疑（o/w）；「岳」与闽南音 ga 相合，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 家官，闽南语称丈夫之父，即公公；对应西语 suegro
entries.en: Hokkien term for husband's father (jia guan), i.e. father-in-law (suegro)

entries.zh: 大人，对长辈（父母、岳父母辈）之尊称；对应西语 suegro/suegra，指姻亲尊长
entries.en: honorific term for elders and parents (da ren); parent-in-law (suegro/suegra)

entries.zh: 岳父，妻之父；西语 suegro de la mujer（就夫而言妻家之父）
entries.en: wife's father; father-in-law on the wife's side (suegro de la mujer)
entries.notes: L 栏花体缩写符 Đ 之展开依赖推断，M 栏 gag/gağu 拼写存疑；义为「岳父」清晰，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 岳母，妻之母
entries.en: wife's mother; mother-in-law on the wife's side (suegra de la mujer)
entries.notes: 义为「岳母」清晰；R 栏 mic qua mic 难解（qua/que 存疑），M 栏 gag bou 无碍。

entries.zh: 外母，妻母（外家之母），即岳母；西语 suegra de la mujer
entries.en: wife's mother (mother of the wife's natal family); mother-in-law
entries.notes: L 栏 in/im 拼写存疑（不碍 suegra de la mujer 之义）；「外母」与闽南音 gua bo 相合，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 夫姆，夫家母辈之称（婆母/岳母辈）；对应西语 suegra，确切指向存疑
entries.en: fu mu, a term for a mother-in-law figure of the husband's family; entered under suegra
entries.notes: M 栏「tio m」尾符难辨；「夫姆」与 suegra 之确切对应存疑，依本页岳父母词条群定其大意。

entries.zh: 大家，闽南语称丈夫之母，即婆婆；对应西语 suegra
entries.en: Hokkien term for husband's mother (da jia), i.e. mother-in-law (suegra)

entries.zh: 底，此条指鞋底；词头 suelas del capat~，capat~ 疑即 zapato（鞋）之别写
entries.en: sole of the shoe; bottom
entries.notes: 缩写 capat~ 之展开依赖推断（与下条 capatos 同指鞋）；R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 鞋底
entries.en: shoe sole (suela del capato/zapato)

entries.zh: 皮底，皮革制的鞋底
entries.en: leather sole (suela de cuero)

entries.zh: 珠釘靴，靴底钉有珠状圆钉之靴；对应西语钉饰靴底（suelas claveteadas de la bota）
entries.en: boots with pearl-like studs on the soles; stud-set boot soles
entries.notes: L 栏 clabe[r/t]eadas 与 botaga 拼写存疑（疑 claveteadas/bota）；依「珠釘靴」与闽南音 chiu teng hia 三字定释义，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 底，物之底部；西语 suelo o baxo de algo（地面、某物之下部）
entries.en: bottom of a thing; ground, floor (suelo, o baxo de algo)

entries.zh: 宙，古注谓屋之栋梁、引申指天地；与「地面/物之下部」之对应存疑
entries.en: zhou, classical term for the ridge-beam of a house or the cosmic expanse; mapping to suelo (ground, underside of a thing) uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字「宙」与西语 suelo/baxo de algo 语义不吻合，M 栏后半 malanpuya 难解，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 舡底，船底（船身之底、舱底）
entries.en: ship's bottom; floor of a vessel (suelo del navio)
entries.notes: L 栏词头后半 dosea/adsea 拼写存疑难解，H 栏舡/船字形存疑；「船底」与闽南音 chun tey 相合，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 島臍，岛屿之脐（岛的中央部位）；西语 carahay 义未详，疑为菲律宾当地语词
entries.en: island's navel, the center of an island; carahay unidentified (possibly a Philippine-language word)
entries.notes: 「島臍」义清晰；M 栏 tiam/tia、chay 拼写存疑，西语 carahay 未能确考，R 栏空白。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅存西语词头 Suelto q. libera.（q/9 存疑），汉字、闽南、官话三栏皆空，无从定中文释义。
